summary: Your Integra has high mileage and is reliable, but safety recalls and age-related maintenance need immediate attention. Most importantly, ensure the passenger airbag recall has been completed to keep your passengers safe.

recalls.summary_plain: Some replacement front lights were sold without amber side reflectors. Other drivers might not see your car as easily at night.
recalls.remedy_plain: The parts maker will replace the lights with approved ones for free.

recalls.summary_plain: Certain replacement headlights and bumper lights were missing amber reflectors. This can reduce how visible your car is in the dark.
recalls.remedy_plain: The manufacturer will replace noncompliant lights for free.

recalls.summary_plain: Certain replacement turn signals and headlights lack amber reflectors. Without them, other drivers may not see your car clearly.
recalls.remedy_plain: The supplier will buy back the recalled lights.

recalls.summary_plain: Some aftermarket front lights were sold without proper amber reflectors. This lowers night visibility and increases crash risk.
recalls.remedy_plain: The distributor will reimburse owners who bought the recalled lights.

recalls.summary_plain: The passenger airbag was welded incorrectly at the factory. It might fail to open during a crash.
recalls.remedy_plain: An Acura dealer will install a new passenger airbag module for free.

known_problems.explanation: Owners reported rapid tire wear and tread separation. Tires are the rubber wheels that grip the road.
Owners reported concerns with airbag deployment readiness. Airbags are safety cushions that inflate instantly during a crash.
Complaints mention transmission slipping or hard shifting. The powertrain includes parts like the transmission that send engine power to your wheels.
Drivers noted overheating and cooling system leaks. The cooling system circulates fluid to keep the engine from melting itself.
Reports include steering stiffness and fluid leaks. The steering system turns the front wheels when you turn the steering wheel.

maintenance_due.service: Timing Belt and Water Pump Replacement
maintenance_due.why: The timing belt keeps engine valves moving in sync with the pistons. If it snaps, the engine destroys itself.
Fresh oil cleans and protects delicate moving metal parts inside the engine.
Engine valves stretch over time and need tiny gap adjustments to prevent loss of power or burnt valves.
Brake fluid absorbs water over time. Old fluid can boil and make the brake pedal feel soft.
Fresh coolant prevents rust inside the engine and keeps it running at the correct temperature.

declined_services.risk_if_ignored: The belt can snap without warning and ruin the entire engine.
Old hoses can burst, causing immediate overheating and head gasket failure.
Moisture can corrode internal brake parts and cause stopping distance to increase.

diy_cards.safety_note: This job requires lifting the vehicle off the ground. Have a professional check the work if you are unsure.
This work involves the vehicle's braking system and requires lifting the car. Have a professional check the work.

disclaimers: Costs and difficulty are estimates, not quotes.
